parameters.description: Currency code for pricing. Defaults to USD on airbnb.com; country-specific domains use their own local currency unless this parameter is set.

parameters.name: include_taxes
parameters.description: When `true`, returns tax-inclusive search-card pricing. Applies to airbnb.com, where taxes normally appear only at checkout; other country-specific domains are unaffected (many, like EU domains, already show tax-inclusive totals by default).
